notes: Bundled marked-up scan solutions (pages 28-56) are handwritten by the teacher; solution page images are scans. No Question 30 exists in the paper (numbering jumps 29 to 31); Section II marks sum to 70 as on the cover. Split per the unrelated-parts rule: Q19 parts (a)-(d) kept as '19' (ice cream data) with (e) Pareto chart as '19(e)'; Q20 -> 20(a), 20(b); Q22 -> 22(a), 22(b). Printed paper issues (transcribed as printed, fix needed): Q19 stem says 11 consecutive days but the table has 12 values (teacher corrects to 12); Q23 'before the end of June' is hand-corrected to 'start' in the solutions copy; Q27 'its'' typo. Teacher solution issues (transcribed as written): Q17 solution uses 2671.50 instead of the printed 2671.25 (final 7.37% is correct for 2671.25); Q20(b) solution uses 4500 instead of 45 000 (correct deposit is $45000/1.005^{36} \approx \$37\,604.02$); Q22(a)(ii) solution says '7 hours' (the ogive gives 28-25=3 students between 3 and 4 hours); Q15(b) says 'Eulerian circuit' though two odd vertices give an Eulerian trail; Q22(b)(iv) last bullet is as written ('whereas more symmetrical', subject missing); Q32(c) solution gives two methods ending in 080 and 082 degrees with no single final answer. Handwritten annotations on the answer pages are not marks; marks_breakdown left null as the guidelines give no criteria. Q7 and Q10 have no working in the solutions (key only). Figure for Q22(a) sits in the stem. Cover shows 'Oakhill College'; task treated as AT2 per bank metadata (Half Yearly).
